# temporal_order_observation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Encodes observed ordering between two observations and its evidence basis.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `earlier_observation_id` | `string` | yes | Earlier observation identity. |
| `later_observation_id` | `string` | yes | Later observation identity. |
| `ordering_basis` | `string` | yes | Clock or sequence basis for ordering. |
| `evidence_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of temporal evidence. |
